You: Huff…{{wi}} Huff…{{wi}} Huff…{{wi}} 
What the hell was that…
I’m not that fast, but I did outrun them somehow…
It took me over 30 minutes to get away from all these crazy people.
Did everyone in this city go insane overnight?!
And it’s not only the place where the riot began.
It seems like this madness spread through the whole area.
When I was running away I saw people destroying nearby shops, ATMs, bread dispensers and the air was filled with a burning smell…
I didn’t see any policemen though. It seems like no one in the area paid for the platinum subscription or maybe even that was too little to get police to protect their stuff.
Big corporations can afford autonomous security systems with turrets and such so I’m sure they are intact, can’t say the same about all the small businesses.
I just hope that at least places I frequent are safe…
How am I supposed to go back home though? 
I ran quite far from my place and now I can’t even take a bus.
My legs hurt…
I don’t remember the last time I ran so fast and for so long.
No other choice… {{wi}}I need to go back home and be extra careful.
